description.html: The tall red-green artificial plant has several upright stems densely covered with small green leaves with red tips. It stands on a small dark base that is easy to cover with substrate.

The advantage of an artificial plant is that it looks the same day after day: it does not rot, lose leaves or need strong lighting or fertilizer. It does not affect water parameters, and fish use it as cover, especially younger and shyer ones.

As one of the taller plants we offer, it is meant for the back of the aquarium, where it hides equipment and cables and adds depth to the scene. The red tones stand out next to green plants in front of it. When algae appear on the leaves, take the plant out, rinse it under lukewarm water and brush it with a soft brush. Do not use chemical cleaners, as residues can end up in the water. Browse our other decorations and equipment.
